name: Saitoo
source:
The protagonist, who was left behind by his wife and his then-kindergartner daughter back when he was still an unemployed scumbag.

Right now, he turned over a new leaf and is now a competent working-adult, but still a scumbag who loves having sex with young women. 

He's currently engrossed in "toilet prostitution", but lately he feels that one of the girls he bought might be his own daughter...

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=863865]Getchu[/url]]
